title: ASUS Vivobook S 14 OLED (S5406)
shortDescription: Premium 14-inch OLED laptop with Intel Core Ultra 7 258V (Lunar Lake) and 32GB memory.
description:
Vivobook S 14 OLED pairs a vivid 14-inch OLED display with the efficient Intel Core Ultra 7 258V processor and 32GB of on-package memory.

It's a Copilot+ PC with a slim metal design in Mist Blue.

Processor: Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor 258V 32GB 2.2 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.8 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 47TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor 256V 16GB 2.2 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.8 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 47TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 5 Processor 228V 32GB 2.1 GHz (8MB Cache, up to 4.5 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 40TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 5 Processor 226V 16GB 2.1 GHz (8MB Cache, up to 4.5 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 40TOPS
Neural Processor: Intel AI Boost NPU up to 49TOPS
Intel AI Boost NPU up to 40TOPS

Display: 3K (2880 x 1800) OLED 16:10 aspect ratio, Refresh Rate:60Hz refresh rate

120Hz refresh rate, peak brightness 600nits, 100% DCI-P3 color gamut, 1,000,000:1, VESA CERTIFIED Display HDR True Black 600, 1.07 billion colors, Glossy display, 70% less harmful blue light, - (Screen-to-body ratio)87%

Storage: 1TB M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD + 100GB Cloud Storage with Microsoft 365 Basic for 1 Year*.
512GB M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD + 100GB Cloud Storage with Microsoft 365 Basic for 1 Year*.

I/O Ports: 2x Thunderbolt 4 with support for display / power delivery (data speed up to 40Gbps)
2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A (data speed up to 5Gbps), 1x 3.5mm Combo Audio Jack
1x HDMI 2.1 TMDS, Micro SD card reader

Input.Keyboard & Touchpad: Backlit Chiclet Keyboard 1-Zone RGB without Num-key, 1.7mm Key-travel, Precision touchpad, With Copilot key
Input.Camera: FHD camera with IR function to support Windows Hello, With privacy shutter

Battery.Power Supply: TYPE-C, 65W AC Adapter, Output: 20V DC, 3.25A, 65W, Input: 100-240V AC 50/60Hz universal, *Whether a charger is included varies according to country, region and model. Please check with your local ASUS retailer for details.

Operating System: Windows 11 Home - ASUS recommends Windows 11 Pro for business, *Windows 11 Home is available only as the Single Language edition in selected markets. Learn more about Windows 11 Home Single language: https://support.microsoft.com/article/eaf060a6-3642-4612-6b75-b34e57a08abf, No preinstalled OS

Security: Microsoft Pluton security processor, IR webcam with Windows Hello support

keySpecs.processor: Intel Core Ultra 7 258V 32GB / Intel Core Ultra 7 256V 16GB / Intel Core Ultra 5 228V 32GB
